text:
maria: deploybot flagged a digest mismatch when publishing myservice:staging-20260321. Tag shows pushed but manifest digest differs from build artifact. rolling hold on staging push. details below.

deploybot: [automated] publish failed for repo myorg/myservice:staging-20260321
  returned manifest digest: sha256:aaa111bbb222ccc333ddd444eee555fff666
  expected build digest: sha256:ccc333bbb222aaa111999888777666555444
  reason: layered manifest index order changed
  see: https://redwood.internal/ops/publish/5601233210

sam: :eyes: is this the same as last week's layer-order flake?
maria: not exactly — the index has same layers but ordering differs, so attestation fingerprint mismatches

registry-bot: GCR reported manifestlist with platform entries reordered during upload. We saw chunk upload finished but final manifest rewrite happened in staging mirror.

anthony: can we pin to previous digest for the canary? we should avoid auto-promote
maria: yes. action: hold auto-promote, pin deployment to sha256:ddd444111aaa222999000bbb333ccc666 for canary. i'll add to release notes and notify QA

jen: checklist? do we need a retag or republish?
maria: prefer republish from CI artifacts. CI shows identical layer contents. propose: 1) block deploybot auto-promo 2) trigger republish with --preserve-index-order flag in publisher 3) run attestation signer again

sam: if republish isn't possible quickly, we can manual-push the canonical digest and update canary pins. risk: short window where clients pull older manifest
maria: rolling plan: hold promotions until 25:10 UTC window, republish in parallel, if republish >30m then manual pin and skip release notes update until next patch.
anthony: +1. i'll open a quick PR to add preserve flag and kick CI

registry-bot: created mirror job 5601233210-republish -> job id 7894
deploybot: note: previous retries failed with error: "manifest list order changed after signing"

maria: copying runbook snippet:
```
# republish steps
1. ./publish --repo myorg/myservice --artifact build/20260321 --preserve-index-order
2. verify cosign attestations: cosign verify-blob --key ksm://signer myorg/myservice@sha256:...
3. update canary pin: kubectl set image deployment/myservice myservice=myorg/myservice@sha256:...
```

jen: QA ready to smoke test once republished. i'll stand by in #eng-sre
maria: will update this thread when republish completes. tagging release-note: 'staging publish held due to manifestlist index reorder; republished and pinned to digest X when complete'

maria: (later) republish finished, new digest sha256:eee777999666555444333222111000abc999, attestation OK, unblocking canary
sam: rolling forward canary now :thumbsup:
maria: closing hold. final note: we'll add index-order-preserve to publisher default to avoid this class of mismatch
